title: Meio Tooltip Fold
summary: Folds the lines other addons pile at the bottom of item tooltips into Blizzard's own, so tooltips stay short.

gallery.title: Before and after
gallery.description: A cloak's tooltip: Pawn, RestedXP and Meionomics lines piled at the bottom, then folded into the tooltip

gallery.title: Hold Shift
gallery.description: Shift brings back Pawn's scale, every guide and Meionomics' full price detail
